messages:
Ana (support): FYI customer C-418 reports high latency and cross-region routing — requests are landing in us-west but they expected eu-central. They attached a curl sample.
Juan (solutions): Can you paste the raw request they sent?
Ana (support): From ticket: ```curl -X POST 
  'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?region=eu' 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <redacted>' 
  -H 'X-Region: ' 
  -H 'X-Client-Region: eu' 
  -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'```
Ana (support): They say SDK sets X-Region to an empty string when client passes null.
Ben (infra): Empty-string header is treated as present by our router today, and it wins header priority over query param. Not good.
Maria (oncall): ingress-bot, can you dump the router decision log for one of their request ids?
ingress-bot: Log for req=01D3Q2Y: got headers {x-region: "", x-client-region: "eu", referer: "client.app"} -> header-priority list [x-region, x-client-region, region_query] -> selected x-region (empty) -> route-> us-west-1 -> reason: explicit header present.
Juan (solutions): So router treats empty value as explicit override. Customer's SDK sends X-Region:"" which blocks region=eu query.
Ana (support): Customer is upset — they see added latency and egress charges. Billing Bot, can we review outbound egress for C-418 across eu vs us-west?
Billing Bot: Ticket BG-772 created. Preliminary: 93GB egress to us-west over last 24h. Escalating to billing team for credit review.
Ben (infra): Short-term mitigation: we can patch router to ignore headers with empty-string or only-whitespace values. Medium-term: update header precedence to prefer x-client-region if x-region is empty.
Maria (oncall): Can we push a quick deploy with guard that treats empty headers as absent? Risk?
Ben (infra): Low-risk hotfix: treat header values matching ^\s*$ as absent in routing. I can roll a canary in staging and prod in ~45m.
Juan (solutions): Meanwhile, for the customer: ask them to remove X-Region or set it to 'eu' or use the SDK patch we gave (v1.2.3) that avoids sending empty header. Provide curl for repro: ```curl -X POST 'https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate?region=eu' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...' -H 'X-Client-Region: eu' -d '{"prompt":"test"}'```
Ana (support): I'll send that and include the ingress log and ticket BG-772. Also adding note to monitor for repeat.
Ben (infra): Logging todo: record when header values are empty and emit metric routing.header.empty_count. Will add alert if >100/min.
Maria (oncall): Assigning incident->tools: infra, severity=low, ETA patch=45m.
Ana (support): Customer replied: "thanks, will test after you push change" :thumbsup:
Juan (solutions): Follow-up action items: 1) hotfix treat-empty-as-absent (infra) 2) SDK patch docs and release note (devex) 3) billing review for credits (billing) 4) add unit tests for header precedence edge-cases (infra+qa)
Maria (oncall): I'll create the incident PR with those tasks and link BG-772.
Ana (support): Closing loop here after patch and customer confirmation. Keeping thread open for deploy results.
Ben (infra): Canary passed on two nodes. Rolling to prod now.
ingress-bot: Deploy complete. Patch applied: header-empty treated as absent. Metric routing.header.empty_count=213 over 24h.
Ana (support): Customer confirmed post-patch they hit eu and latency normalized. They asked about credits.
Billing Bot: Billing team reviewing, will update BG-772 with decision within 48h.
Ana (support): Thanks all. Filing postmortem notes: root cause = SDK sent empty X-Region header; router considered empty header as explicit; fix = ignore empty headers + SDK update.
Juan (solutions): Suggestion: add a lint rule in SDKs to never send headers with empty values to avoid regression.
Ben (infra): Agree. Adding to infra backlog.
Maria (oncall): Marking incident resolved after billing decision and SDK release. :white_check_mark:
